name: qlrisk_price_trades
title: Price trades
description: Price one or more trades with qlrisk: NPV in the trade currency and the reporting currency, pricing components (forward, vol, spread ...), analytic Greeks where the pricer gives them, and optional cash flows. Use this for 'what is it worth'; use qlrisk_sensitivities for DV01/CS01/delta/vega/theta. Market data defaults to qlrisk's sample snapshot valued today (override any curve, spot or vol). Trades take the inputs of each product's qlrisk_price_<product> tool (rates in percent, spreads in basis points, maturity as a tenor like 5Y); confidence levels are in percent (99 = 99%). Inputs: trades; the rest (market_data, reporting_currency, include_cash_flows) in the optional `advanced` object. Example: {"trades": [{"product": "InterestRateSwap", "trade_id": "IRS-5Y", "maturity": "5Y", "notional": 10000000, "fixed_rate_pct": 4.4, "counterparty_id": "BANK-A"}, {"product": "CorporateBond", "trade_id": "ACME-5Y", "maturity": "5Y", "face_value": 5000000, "coupon_pct": 5, "issuer": "ACME", "counterparty_id": "ACME"}]} gives 2 trade(s) priced on 2026-10-09: total NPV 4,863,978.06 USD on qlrisk's sample market valued 2026-10-09.
